ex.zh: 有时我和朋友们会争吵，却不知道怎样和好。

ex.en: They had a fight yesterday, but they made up this morning.
ex.zh: 他们昨天吵了一架，但今天早上和好了。

ex.en: I understand, but meeting in person is not always easy.
ex.zh: 我明白，但亲自见面并不总是那么容易。

ex.en: Can you imagine talking with some historical characters in person?
ex.zh: 你能想象亲自和一些历史人物交谈吗？

ex.en: Some of you may prefer texting, but it takes longer and can make things worse if you're not careful with your words.
ex.zh: 你们有些人可能更喜欢发短信，但这样更费时间，而且如果说话不注意，会让事情变得更糟。

ex.en: As for me, I prefer to study with a group.
ex.zh: 至于我，我更喜欢和小组一起学习。

ex.en: If you stay calm and say sorry, it will help.
ex.zh: 如果你保持冷静并道歉，会有帮助的。

ex.en: The dogs must be calm, follow orders, and behave well.
ex.zh: 这些狗必须冷静、服从命令、表现良好。

ex.en: Why does Jason worry about talking on the phone?
ex.zh: 为什么贾森担心打电话？

ex.en: The artist smiled and said, "Don't worry about what others think."
ex.zh: 这位艺术家笑着说：“别担心别人怎么想。”

ex.en: What expressions can you use to talk about future plans?
ex.zh: 你可以用哪些表达来谈论未来的计划？

ex.en: Have you noticed the new and cool expressions online?
ex.zh: 你注意到网上那些新潮的表达了吗？

ex.en: If you want to make some new friends, this is a good chance.
ex.zh: 如果你想交些新朋友，这是个好机会。

ex.en: It was a great chance to enjoy and understand traditional culture.
ex.zh: 这是一个欣赏和了解传统文化的好机会。

ex.en: Now I think meeting new people is really fun!
ex.zh: 现在我觉得结识新朋友真的很有趣！

ex.en: After knowing the reason, the family had a meeting.
ex.zh: 知道原因后，全家人开了个会。

ex.en: But there were also difficulties, and sometimes I just wanted to give up.
ex.zh: 但也有困难，有时我真想放弃。

ex.en: We can also see Chinese people's strong will to overcome any difficulty.
ex.zh: 我们还能看到中国人战胜一切困难的坚强意志。

ex.en: I'll call you right away.
ex.zh: 我马上给你打电话。

ex.en: "She won our hearts right away," said Carrie's mother, laughing.
ex.zh: “她一下子就赢得了我们的心。”卡丽的妈妈笑着说。

ex.en: Please write your name on the first line.
ex.zh: 请把你的名字写在第一行。

ex.en: They crossed the finish line as a group.
ex.zh: 他们一起冲过了终点线。

ex.en: Drop me a line when you get to Beijing.
ex.zh: 到北京后给我写封信吧。

ex.en: Please drop me a line and tell me about your new school.
ex.zh: 请给我写封信，说说你的新学校。

ex.en: Don't share personal details, like your address, school name, or phone number.
ex.zh: 不要分享个人信息，比如你的住址、学校名称或电话号码。

ex.en: Your summary should include the basic information without unnecessary details.
ex.zh: 你的摘要应包括基本信息，不要有多余的细节。

ex.en: We have a family reunion dinner on the eve of the Spring Festival.
ex.zh: 除夕我们全家吃团圆饭。

ex.en: Our class will have a reunion ten years later.
ex.zh: 我们班十年后要聚会。

ex.en: But promise me you'll think about it seriously.
ex.zh: 但答应我，你会认真考虑这件事。

ex.en: More seriously, it can make it harder to think clearly, solve problems, or stay calm.
ex.zh: 更严重的是，它会让人更难清晰思考、解决问题或保持冷静。

ex.en: The new season is coming, so it's time to make a plan for our training.
ex.zh: 新赛季就要到了，是时候制订训练计划了。

ex.en: He kept training, taking part in competitions, and winning prizes.
ex.zh: 他坚持训练、参加比赛、获得奖项。

ex.en: Do you get nervous when you talk to someone?
ex.zh: 你和别人说话时会紧张吗？

ex.en: Her coach and mother sat beside me, as nervous as I was.
ex.zh: 她的教练和妈妈坐在我旁边，和我一样紧张。

ex.en: Do you find it hard to have a conversation with a stranger?
ex.zh: 你觉得和陌生人交谈很难吗？

ex.en: But now, he speaks confidently in front of strangers.
ex.zh: 但现在，他在陌生人面前也能自信地说话。
